ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 8:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white field covering ~88% of the fluke; continuous black perimeter along the trailing edge and distal tips; large irregular black patch at the peduncle-fluke junction; two distinct isolated black circular spots on the medial right lobe; three smaller black dots clustered on the proximal lower-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep U-shaped central notch with an estimated interior angle of 35-40 degrees; depth is approximately 10-12% of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Trailing edge exhibits irregular low-amplitude serrations; highest frequency of edge variations (peaks/valleys) occurs at the distal tips; left distal tip shows deeper horizontal jaggedness compared to the right.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex-upward sweep from the median notch extending to the distal tips; lobes exhibit a slight posterior S-curve trajectory at the outer margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two prominent, roughly circular black pixel clusters on the middle-right quadrant of the right lobe; a small grouping of three dark spots on the lower-left lobe medial area.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct set of 6-8 parallel, horizontal linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) localized on the distal edge of the left fluke tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple parallel linear rake marks on the far-left distal tip; several localized circular pigmentation spots or scars distributed across both lobes.
